gate: every register and pin touched by step 5 returned to its pre-step value
note: one earlier attempt at the phase-C sweep was killed by a host-side 2-minute tool timeout, and because the trap did not cover SIGHUP the radio was left with the tone on, 0x035=0x03 and CTRL_OUT exported. It was explicitly restored and verified before continuing, and HUP was added to the trap for every later phase. No CTRL_IN pin was armed at any point during that window.
